Samen werken aan een betere wereld: Working together towards a better world
Een greep uit onze initiatieven van afge: A selection of our initiatives from the past year to reduce our impact on the environment and promote social sustainability:
In 2025 hebben we een afvalreductie van: In 2025 we achieved a waste reduction of 36% compared to 2024. Through further optimisation of return flows, better separation of materials and reuse of packaging, residual waste has been significantly reduced.
Ons wagenpark is in 2025 uitgebreid met: In 2025, our vehicle fleet was expanded with 3 additional electric vehicles. As a result, more than 15% of the total fleet is now electric. These vehicles are used for both urban and regional removals and make a direct contribution to further reducing our CO₂ emissions.
Dankzij de inzet van duurzame en herbrui: Thanks to the use of sustainable and reusable materials, we managed to save 35,000 moving boxes in 2025. Our cardboard boxes continue to be made from 100% recycled material and are fully recyclable. In addition, we continue to actively focus on minimising plastic packaging materials
Ook in 2025 hebben onze medewerkers acti: In 2025 too, our employees actively focused on sustainable practices. Through refresher training and practical instructions, sustainability remains a fixed part of our daily work, both on location and on the road.
Wij hebben onze samenwerkingen met duurz: We have further deepened our partnerships with sustainable partners. From our 6 hubs in the Netherlands and Belgium, we're increasingly handling deliveries on a decentralised basis, resulting in shorter transport distances, lower emissions and more efficient logistics for our customers.
Voor emissies die nog niet volledig kunn: For emissions that cannot yet be fully avoided, we continue to invest in CO₂ offset programmes. In 2025 we again contributed to forest restoration projects and sustainable energy initiatives, both in the Netherlands and internationally.
Een tweede kans voor textiel en huisraad: A second chance for textiles and household goods
Onze service waarbij klanten oude huisra: Our service, where customers can hand over old household goods and textiles for a second life, continues to grow. In 2025 we again contributed to extending the lifespan of materials and reducing waste. Reuse has thus become a fixed part of moving house. Together with our partner Tex.nl, we ensure that collected textiles are responsibly reused or recycled. This makes it easy for customers to make conscious choices during a removal, and together we contribute to a circular economy.
Maatschappelijke betrokkenheid vormt een: Social involvement is an essential part of our vision on sustainable business. We believe that real sustainability goes beyond environmental impact alone and is also about people, communities and equal opportunities. By actively taking responsibility and committing to social initiatives, we aim to make a positive and lasting contribution to the society in which we operate.
In totaal hebben wij 17 goede doelen en: In total, we supported 17 charities and social initiatives, ranging from local projects to national organisations. In doing so, we actively contribute to an inclusive and engaged society.

Verdere uitbreiding van het elektrische: Further expansion of the electric vehicle fleet
Nog meer afvalreductie en circulaire ver: Even more waste reduction and circular removal solutions
Intensivering van samenwerkingen met maa: Intensifying partnerships with social and local initiatives
Duurzaamheid en maatschappelijke betrokk: Sustainability and social involvement are an ongoing process and a fixed part of how we work. The steps we took in 2025 underline our ambition to do business responsibly and with an eye on the future.
